args.title: Incident summary: double charge on retry
args.body:
Customers were being double-charged on payment captures, with roughly 40 orders per day affected. Maya traced the root cause to retry.py not carrying the idempotency key across the second capture attempt, and Jordan confirmed it in staging. The fix is to persist the idempotency key before the first capture and is already in PR #481, which is pending.

_Source: Slack thread 18291 in #payments, summarized by a delegated worker agent scoped to that thread only._
